editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. PNA ("absorbiendo las inversas de los canales de ruido aprendidos en los observables") and SLC ("acotar de forma más precisa la sensibilidad") are rendered accurately, and the register is informal ("Consulta"). Two small edits: in [6], "de bajo overhead" leaves an English word where a native technical writer would write "de baja sobrecarga". In [10], "Cancelación Probabilística de Errores" copies English title case, but Spanish orthography uses lowercase for a technique name like this.

examples.translation: integra la detección de errores cuánticos de bajo overhead
examples.suggested: integra la detección de errores cuánticos de baja sobrecarga
examples.why: "Overhead" is an unnecessary anglicism here, and Spanish has an established equivalent ("sobrecarga").

examples.translation: aplicaciones ... de la Cancelación Probabilística de Errores (PEC)
examples.suggested: aplicaciones ... de la cancelación probabilística de errores (PEC)
examples.why: English title case is copied over; Spanish writes a technique name like this in lowercase.

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout, with the three run() pre-flight checks in [9], the TEM-vs-PEC shot claim in [69] ("con menos disparos que el método PEC") and the Sharpe-ratio example in [35] all carried over exactly, and terms consistent ("funciones de circuito", "mitigación de errores", tú register).

Faithful and natural; "skills" is consistently rendered "habilidades" and "changelog" as "Registro de cambios", and entry [5] correctly says the migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime skill was released ("Se lanzó la habilidad") for migrating code.

The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and it keeps the informal tú voice ("Consulta", "visita", "Lee"). In entry [9], "AI-powered transpiler passes" becomes "pasadas de transpilador impulsadas por IA", and the "might be faster" caveat stays as "podrían ser más rápidas".

The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. "Pasadas de transpilador", "medición proyectiva conjunta", "tolerante a fallos" and the informal "tú" forms (Escribe, Visita, Lee) are all correct. Two spots are stiff and read like English. Entry 10 uses the calqued gerund "desbloqueando la compilación". Entry 15 has the clumsy repetition "notas de la versión de todas las versiones".

examples.translation: desbloqueando la compilación a computación basada en Pauli
examples.suggested: lo que hace posible compilar a computación basada en Pauli
examples.why: 'Desbloquear' is a calque of 'unlock'. It is also a trailing gerund of consequence, which Spanish style guides discourage.

examples.source: To see the release notes for all versions
examples.translation: Para consultar las notas de la versión de todas las versiones
examples.suggested: Para consultar las notas de todas las versiones
examples.why: Saying 'versión' and then 'versiones' right after it is awkward. A native writer would simplify this.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Dates, repetition-delay ranges, retirement caveats and the three-way Qiskit Runtime naming explanation all match the English, and I found no drift or hallucination. The problems are consistency ones. 'Gate' is 'puertas' almost everywhere but 'compuertas' in [272]. [272] also uses 'stack de motor' and 'jobs' where the rest of the file has 'pila del motor' ([262]) and 'trabajos'. 'Primitive' is feminine 'primitivas' in [45]/[61]/[129] but masculine 'Los primitivos' in [281]/[291]. The file switches between 'computadora cuántica' ([43]-[46], [95]) and 'ordenador cuántico' ([148], [151], [178], [180]), and QPU is masculine 'El primer QPU' in [8] but feminine everywhere else. Month headings are capitalized in some places ('Septiembre/Agosto/Julio/Octubre de') and lowercase in others ('mayo/abril/marzo de').

examples.source: Note that this engine stack is not compatible with fractional gates, pulse gates, or dynamic circuits.
examples.translation: Ten en cuenta que este stack de motor no es compatible con compuertas fraccionarias, compuertas de pulso, ni circuitos dinámicos.
examples.suggested: Ten en cuenta que esta pila del motor no es compatible con puertas fraccionarias, puertas de pulso ni circuitos dinámicos.
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 'puertas' and 'pila del motor' ([258], [262]). This entry also says 'jobs' where the file otherwise says 'trabajos'.

examples.source: V1 primitives are no longer supported.
examples.translation: Los primitivos V1 ya no tienen soporte.
examples.suggested: Las primitivas V1 ya no tienen soporte.
examples.why: The file uses feminine 'primitivas de Qiskit' in [45], [46] and [61]. [281] and [291] switch to masculine 'primitivos'.

examples.source: The first Nighthawk r2 QPU is now available
examples.translation: El primer QPU Nighthawk r2 ya está disponible
examples.suggested: La primera QPU Nighthawk r2 ya está disponible
examples.why: Everywhere else the file treats QPU as feminine ('la primera QPU Nighthawk r1' [86], 'la QPU' [103]).

examples.source: The quantum computer `ibm_brisbane` has been retired
examples.translation: El ordenador cuántico `ibm_brisbane` se ha retirado
examples.suggested: La computadora cuántica `ibm_brisbane` se ha retirado
examples.why: The file mixes 'computadora cuántica' ([43]-[46], [95]) with 'ordenador cuántico' ([148], [151], [178]). One variant should be used consistently.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful and nothing here would mislead a learner. The beta caveat and the "0.47.0 o posterior" version requirement are intact, and terminology is consistent (primitiva Executor, mitigación y supresión de errores, postselección basada en mediciones). Entry [6] has two small English carry-overs a native editor would fix: a serial comma before "y" ("(TREX), y [postselección…]"), which Spanish style does not use, and the calqued gerund "incluyendo" where "como" or "entre ellas" reads more naturally. Entry [0] uses the same "incluyendo" calque.

examples.source: including shaded lightcones, probabilistic error cancellation (PEC), Twirled Readout Error eXtinction (TREX), and [measurement-based postselection]
examples.translation: incluyendo shaded lightcones, cancelación probabilística de errores (PEC), Twirled Readout Error eXtinction (TREX), y [postselección basada en mediciones]
examples.suggested: entre ellas shaded lightcones, cancelación probabilística de errores (PEC), Twirled Readout Error eXtinction (TREX) y [postselección basada en mediciones]
examples.why: Spanish does not use a serial comma before 'y', and the gerund 'incluyendo' is a calque of English 'including'.

examples.source: including the latest package release summaries and platform updates
examples.translation: incluyendo los últimos resúmenes de lanzamiento de paquetes y actualizaciones de la plataforma
examples.suggested: con los últimos resúmenes de versiones de paquetes y novedades de la plataforma
examples.why: The calqued gerund and the stacked 'resúmenes de lanzamiento de paquetes' read as translationese.
